reviews.text: Exceptional service!! The staff were lovely and the way they treated pets was a 10/10. I went to bathe my dog ​​and she came out thrilled. I'll definitely be back. 100% recommended

We took Glück to the groomer and also bought his food, treats, and other supplies there. We're delighted; Jessi is super friendly and kind, and you can tell she loves her job. Glück is a Schnauzer, and he needs stripping every eight weeks, and he comes out looking like a prince! We also took him for a bath. The service was excellent. Jessi even offered to bring us the food and Glück home after his bath if we couldn't go. We didn't need it, but we really appreciate how good, friendly, and professional the service and treatment are.

I loved my experience at Brujo&Bela. The owner, Jessi, is a true professional with a huge heart for animals. My pet left there looking like a star, with a perfect haircut and a shine in his coat I'd never seen before. The service is excellent, and it's clear that Jessi and her team love what they do. I'll definitely be back!
They're fantastic and incredibly kind to animals. It's my go-to shop.
Very good experience, I always find the best food for my pets and with fantastic advice.
It's our go-to shop! They treat us and give us great advice!! Cheers from Brioche
Today we took our furry friend for a bath and we couldn't be happier with the service, the friendliness, and the professionalism. 100% recommended.

Today I visited BRUJO & BELLA to buy food for my pet and I loved the experience 🐾
The shop is very welcoming, with a great variety of food and pet care products.
Plus, I met Brujo, a big, super affectionate dog that I couldn't stop petting 🐶💛
The owner is lovely, very kind, and helped me choose exactly what I needed.

I'll definitely be back! 🐕

A fantastic shop and hair salon. From day one they've been incredibly kind and attentive to our Niebla, and my children are thrilled with the shop. I'm posting before and after photos 😊 I highly recommend it. …

I love seeing shops growing little by little in the neighborhood! Since it opened, I've been taking my dog ​​Catalina: she always comes out of the bath super soft and happy because they give her treats... haha. You can tell they do everything with a lot of love and that they love furry friends. Plus, they have a great variety of products, all very high quality and super natural. Here's to continued growth!
The best dog shop and groomer in the neighborhood ❤️ They're friendly and professional with our furry children 🐶🐾 …
Excellent service, but it doesn't stop there. A great variety and excellent quality in all their products. 100% recommended.

We stumbled upon this place by chance and we're so happy. After the summer, we were too embarrassed to take our dog because he was a mess... You know that feeling of not daring to go to the groomer because your dog is filthy? Well, they made him look perfect, and the price was great.
The experience was fantastic; we took our dog in to be washed and they left him spotless. It's a very pleasant place and the service was excellent.
Disappointed, I went for a "too good to go" pack and they tried to trick me by giving me a pack that cost 5 euros but should have been 15.
It's a pleasure to visit the store. They're very attentive and friendly. We stop by whenever we can.

Excellent service and outstanding professionals.
Thank you so much.

Gentleness, kindness, professionalism, and friendliness.
Nasha looks gorgeous after the bath you gave her. Thank you so much, you've definitely earned it. 😘😘😘 …

It was our first time at the hairdresser's and we were delighted. Wifi looked great and was very happy. Both of them were wonderful and made everything easy. Thank you so much for everything. See you soon.

Cati and Nina go to Brujo and Bella's grooming salon where Jess bathes them with so much love that the two old ladies relax and calm down. They leave looking gorgeous and feeling pampered 😂
Thank you, Jessica, for opening this lovely place for our furry friends 🐾🐾
The best service! Every time we go we receive the best treatment!! Highly recommended.
Due to an emergency, they kindly helped us even though they had just closed and saved us! They were incredibly attentive and friendly.
They've made my dog ​​look very handsome.
100% 100% recommendable, super professional, and lovely people, one of those places that when you go once with your dog and you pass by again, it drives you crazy to go back in 🤣 …

A fantastic, trustworthy local business!

I'm so glad I found this pet shop in the neighborhood.
It's rare to find places with such personalized attention, something my Silver and I really appreciate. Plus, the atmosphere is so welcoming and friendly. It's great to know you can trust a local shop to take care of your pets. I highly recommend this place!
My dog ​​Adam's favorite place. The owners are lovely and always have great advice. Thank you so much!

Today Sam had a wonderful bath at the "brujo&bella" pet shop in Madrid. The service he received was amazing 😍 They pampered him so much he didn't want to come home. Thank you so much for taking such good care of Sam. …

This is the place I'd been looking for for ages. Before leaving my friend Darko, I spoke with Jessy; my impression was that she loved her job and our four-legged friends. I wasn't wrong: Darko came out looking gorgeous, and we were thrilled with the care he received.

Thank you so much. A perfect 10!
The owner is lovely; you can tell she loves animals. I went to bathe my Maltese, Coco, and they made him look so handsome!

We are delighted with Brujo & Bella.
Jessi is lovely and always greets every customer with such warmth. She adores animals, and they know it... That's why they're always so happy to visit her. Coen loves stopping by and getting some pampering (in addition to the treats he helps himself...).
The quality-price ratio is excellent, and I love the personalized service. They work with top brands. They also offer home delivery and have a fantastic grooming service at a great price. It's definitely worth a visit.
This shop has brought so much joy to the area.

When the owners of a pet shop have two such gorgeous and well-cared-for dogs as Brujo and Bella, you know you're in good hands. The owners are lovely; they pamper every dog ​​that comes in, offer advice, and help with everything. A real treat!
Wonderful treatment of the animals

Excellent service... 20 out of 10. They're so friendly and pamper the little ones as if they were their own. 200% recommended. The shop has everything you could need, and the grooming section is fantastic. My Dana left thrilled... Very clean, no shedding, and smells great. I'll definitely be back.

It was about time we had a shop like this in the neighborhood. Jessica is so lovely! She's so friendly and caring; my fur babies love going there. She has great products, and her recommendations are spot on. You can definitely see the love in her work.

Thank you for your review, Remedios!
Duna has charmed us with her sweet face, and what can we say about how wonderful she is? We're delighted to have you!
New place in the area, I went once with my dog, they were friendly, treated him with care and left him clean and handsome... I don't need anything more!

Brujo y Bella is much more than a pet shop: it's a place where love and care for the furry friends who are part of our lives are palpable. Jessica, the owner, has created a unique and warm space where every detail reflects her passion and dedication to animals.

In this shop, you'll find everything your pet needs: excellent quality food, fun toys, useful accessories, and products that make a difference in the daily lives of our companions. But what truly makes Brujo y Bella special is the personalized attention Jessica offers, always with a smile and advice born from her knowledge and experience.

It's a place that combines professionalism and love, where every customer, human or animal, feels welcome and cared for. Brujo y Bella isn't just a shop; it's a magical haven for those who see their pets as part of the family. Without a doubt, it's a place you'll want to visit again and again.

If animals could talk, they'd surely say, "Take me to Brujo & Bella, human." This new gem in the neighborhood near Conde Casal is paradise for any pet... and their owners, too.

Jessica, the owner and heart of the shop, not only knows what she's doing, she does it with passion! It's clear she loves animals more than many of us love our plants (and that's saying something). Professional, friendly, and always with a smile, she advises you as if she's known your dog your whole life.

Looking for a bed for your cat with a king complex? A treat for your gourmet dog? A toy to make your hamster feel like it's in an amusement park? They have it! And if they don't, Jessica is probably already thinking about getting it for you.

At Brujo & Bella, everything has a special touch: every corner of the shop is designed so that you and your pet can find exactly what you're looking for. The love and dedication are evident in every detail.

If you want your four-legged companion (or two, or none at all) to receive the very best, stop by. Jessica and her shop are, without a doubt, the new must-visit spot in the neighborhood.

P.S.: Humans are welcome too.

Jessi treated us wonderfully. I went with my 15-year-old dog, and she recommended a senior dog food. She was incredibly kind to Zeus, even giving us exercise tips and guidelines that might be more or less beneficial for his age. I think they also offer dog washing services. I highly recommend them for their excellent service; we'll definitely be back.
The best pet store in the neighborhood. They have everything, and it's all excellent quality. Plus, they have a grooming salon.
They are lovely and treat the dogs wonderfully. 100% recommended.

They treat people very politely and have a great capacity for loving dogs.

It's a fantastic shop with a wide variety of high-quality wet and dry food, treats for both dogs and cats. They also have great dog accessories: leashes, harnesses, collars, halters, etc. They also have toys and litter for cats.

They even have a grooming service, and both owners and their dogs always leave happy.

My dog's name is Haku, and he's a bit of an oddball, but ever since we took him to BRUJO&BELLA, he's been thrilled, and so are we. He's connected with Jessica in a special way, and it's no wonder—she's lovely.
Excellent service, everyone was very friendly. The dogs seemed very relaxed and it was clear they loved it.
Jessica is a sweetheart and incredibly affectionate with the dogs. 100% recommended. She has a great variety of dog food, and having a shop in the neighborhood is so convenient.

It's such a treat to have this shop in the neighborhood! We went to bathe my dog, Sia. Since she's a bit timid, we were worried about how she'd handle the bath, but it went wonderfully! Jessi was incredibly attentive, caring, and gentle with her. The glass enclosure so you can watch her being bathed is a real plus and gives you peace of mind because my dog ​​could see me the whole time. Needless to say, she looked amazing; she's a German Shepherd mix, and it looked fantastic on her.
Of course, we also took the opportunity to buy some accessories and try some of their treats, which she absolutely loved!
In short, impeccable service with the best products. You can tell they truly love animals!

The best pet shop ever!! Since it opened, I've been visiting at least once a week. We really needed a shop like this in the area, and who better than Jess to open it! All my furry friends are thrilled with every product we buy! Don't hesitate to stop by and have a look because the service is 10/10, just like all the products 🖤 …

The other day I took my Troy in for a bath and a little grooming of his coat and ears, and what a wonderful job they did! They manage to change them with so much care.

We'll be back because he left so happy! He loved his appointment.

PS: I wholeheartedly recommend them to everyone! ✨🥰

Finally, a pet store near home! Jessy gives me the best advice on feeding my dogs, and she also has an excellent grooming salon where she treats the dogs with so much love. I'm thrilled!
HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

I found this place through Google while searching for a place to get my German Shepherd groomed. My dog ​​and I were very happy with the results; they clearly work with great care and attention to detail. We'll definitely be back.
It's a pleasure to go to stores like this; the service is friendly, personal, and specialized, and they also have good prices and a wide variety of food and accessories. It's highly recommended.
Jessica is a delight. She treats my dog ​​with so much love, and taking him for a bath makes him feel happy with her. I highly recommend the shop.
I'm delighted with this shop! They have a huge selection of products! Plus, the way they treated my dogs was fantastic. I highly recommend it, I'll definitely be back!

An excellent shop! The owner is very friendly and recommended a dog food for our 12-year-old dog, and it's been fantastic.
I recommend their grooming services and the wide variety of products they offer. I'll definitely be back for the great service and attention. 😁 …
